rules.name: state-transition authorization
rules.requirement: Every security-relevant work-item state transition MUST carry caller identity, project/workspace scope, explicit transition capability and an ALLOW decision from the canonical FA3 authorization authority.

rules.name: event/action authorization separation
rules.requirement: The occurrence or receipt of an event MUST NOT itself authorize the action triggered by that event; action execution requires a separate canonical authorization decision.

rules.name: no integration-wide authorization bypass
rules.requirement: A global/application integration credential MUST NOT bypass actor-, project-, workspace- or capability-scoped authorization on the canonical runtime path.

rules.name: provider-neutral work-item identity
rules.requirement: Kanboard task/project identifiers are provider projection identifiers and MUST NOT replace canonical FA3 work-item identity.

rules.name: explicit remote-state reconciliation
rules.requirement: Remote provider state MUST carry an observed provider revision plus explicit synchronization/reconciliation state before it can affect canonical workflow state.

rules.name: webhook normalization boundary
rules.requirement: Kanboard webhook input MUST be authenticated/validated and normalized into a typed canonical event envelope; the webhook payload alone is neither authorization proof nor canonical evidence.

rules.name: plugin supply-chain admission
rules.requirement: A Kanboard plugin used by FA3 requires source identity, pinned version, immutable digest, provenance verification, licence admission and policy admission; ad-hoc web installation is forbidden on the canonical production path.

rules.name: plugin non-authority
rules.requirement: Plugin extensibility MUST NOT grant identity, authorization, workflow, event, evidence, secrets, egress, artifact-trust or other FA3 architectural authority.

rules.name: provider URL egress boundary
rules.requirement: A provider- or plugin-configured outbound URL does not constitute network-egress authorization; canonical egress admission plus SSRF and DNS-rebinding controls are required.

rules.name: provider failure isolation
rules.requirement: Loss or inconsistency of the optional Kanboard provider MUST NOT replace, corrupt or become fail-open authority for canonical FA3 workflow/work-item state.

rules.name: disabled provider near-zero runtime cost
rules.requirement: When disabled/reference-only, Kanboard MUST impose no resident provider process, background worker, network session, accelerator reservation or active polling requirement on FA3.

rules.name: provider non-authority invariant
rules.requirement: FA3-PROVIDER-KANBOARD-001 remains optional, non-root and non-authoritative, adds no capability and preserves the canonical capability count of 143.
